messages:
liang: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a "probe+hedge" admission pattern to reduce noisy retries during quota saturation. High level: tiny instrumented probes + optional hedges to warm spare pools. Want tradeoffs.

priya: Can you sketch the sequence? Is this admission-time only or per-request hedging?

liang: Sequence: router requests PROBE token (very small). Admission replies PROBE_ACCEPT + hint. Router sends probe to primary; if probe latency > threshold within T ms, router issues hedged request to spare. Probe budget is tight per-tenant.

tony: Probes could amplify load. Limits?

liang: Limits: PROBE_CREDIT per tenant, max_probe_concurrency, and probe_rate cap (e.g., 0.1 rps default). Probes charge probe-credit; winner pays normal token.

emily: Need cache/warmness metadata. Hedging to cold pool is expensive.

liang: Admission will include pool metadata: "cache_version" and "warm_score". Router should prefer spares with warm_score > threshold.

security-bot: Attack surface: discovery via probes. Mitigations: require probe_eligibility, block probes for high-abuse tenants, and audit probe usage.

priya: Telemetry: probe_attempts_total, probe_wins_by_pool, probe_charge_consumed, hedged_failures. Dashboards for per-tenant probe_loss_ratio.

tony: Operational: Admission needs warm_score stream. Can be an EWMA pushed from pool telemetry. Lightweight, not DB-bound.

liang: Rollout plan: feature-flagged. Canary with Dedicated low-risk tenants -> 1% host pool -> 10% -> ramp. Default conservative probe params.

infra-bot: Added playbook: /internal/playbooks/probe-hedge

liang: Action items:
- liang: draft sequence diag + probe semantics (EOD)
- tony: define warm_score metric + contract (2d)
- priya: dashboard mockups (1d)
- emily: abuse gating + eligibility matrix (tomorrow)

priya: +1 to PROBE_CREDIT naming.

qa-bot: Please add QA scenarios: cold cache hedging, probe-amplification simulation, abuse gated flows.

liang: Thanks all. Sync 10:30 tomorrow to finalize.
